description:
I’m sagar, an engineering admission and career counsellor passionate about helping students choose the right path.
I provide guidance for college and branch selection across Maharashtra, considering ranks, cutoffs, and career aspirations.
My services include CAP round planning, cutoff analysis, and accurate option filling.
I emphasize clear, honest, and practical advice to make the admission process smooth and stress-free.
My aim is to help students make confident decisions for a successful academic journey.
